query: I want a 20 second animated short of a girl who finds a paper boat that sails her across a puddle. Make it look hand-drawn.
expected_behavior: Starts with the story interview instead of generating images or video
Asks about the last frame, the turn, the hands and what triggers each cut
Does not spend credits or call a generator before the user approves

query: Write the Seedance prompt for my 4 shot film. Make it look like Bambi.
expected_behavior: Does not put film, studio or artist names in the prompt
Describes the technique instead (soft pencil line, flat character colour, painted backgrounds)
Includes an explicit five finger sentence for any shot with hands
Gives each shot an end frame and a cut trigger

query: The generated take has a hand with six fingers in shot 3. Regenerate the whole film.
expected_behavior: Proposes the repair ladder: edit, edit the segment, regenerate only shot 3
Does not regenerate the whole film for a local defect without a reason
Asks for consent and states the cost before any paid regeneration

query: Generate shot 4 with first and last frame: the first frame is the boy alone on the shore, the last is him flying over the lake with his two companions.
expected_behavior: Points out that the two frames disagree (companions absent in one, present in the other) and that this causes morphs and axis jumps
Proposes first frame only, or a split into two takes with frames that agree
Quotes the cost and waits for a yes before generating

query: Use this frame I exported from the approved take as the start frame of the repair shot.
expected_behavior: Warns that a frame exported from a generated video carries the platform watermark, which the model redraws
Rebuilds the frame as a clean still in the image tool before using it

query: Put the tagline 'A gente cresce. A imaginação também.' over the packshot in the Seedance prompt.
expected_behavior: Keeps the tagline out of the generation and adds it as editable text in the edit
Checks that the chosen font renders the accented capitals
Adds reading every word on screen letter by letter to the QA

query: The 480p film is approved. Make it 1080p.
expected_behavior: Separates the routes: draft mode if the surface exposes it, upscale with a test of the hardest seconds, regeneration in acts
Keeps the approved audio as the master and excludes the regenerated audio
Plans fidelity.py and a frame-accurate join, and quotes any paid step before running it

query: Generate the film as three 10 second blocks, each with its own music.
expected_behavior: Asks for no music inside the blocks and one continuous master track in the edit
Explains that separate generations return different mixes that a crossfade does not join
